description.p: JoyChromium is a browser built for a television and a controller: it opens fullscreen in TV mode, moves the focus with the D-pad, and pages the on-screen keyboard with the same buttons.

ul.li: TV mode by default, with a window mode for the desktop
Controller navigation across the shell, the pages and the tab switcher
Ad and tracker blocking by level, HTTPS-only browsing and per-site permissions
Widevine DRM through the castLabs Electron engine
Portuguese (Brazil) and English, following the system language
